title: How common is autism?
metaTitle: Understanding the Prevalence of Autism: Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Autism is a part of our world today. Embrace a deeper understanding of autism prevalence and how Pinnacle Blooms Network can help individuals reach their full potential.
html: Autism is a part of our world, affecting about 1 in 39 boys in the US, and is four times more likely to occur in boys than girls. It's important for every one of us to understand the nuances of autism, as it's fairly common in today's society. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we work tirelessly with each one of our young clients to enable them to reach their utmost potential.
